results.original_text: As a site editor, I want to have pretty good control over how the article, so that articles are visually appealing.
results.final_text:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want to have comprehensive control over the article formatting and layout so that I can ensure all published articles are visually appealing and engaging for readers.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Editors should be able to customize at least 7 different aspects of the article's presentation (such as font style, color scheme, image placement, headings, spacing, lists, and links).
- The article preview feature must render changes in real-time, with updates appearing within 1 second of adjustments being made.
- User satisfaction regarding the editing capabilities should reach at least 90% as measured through post-publication surveys.

Test Outline:
- Verify the functionality of each formatting option by editing sample articles and checking the applied changes in the preview.
- Measure the time taken for real-time updates to appear during editing sessions to confirm compliance with the 1-second requirement.

results.original_text: I want a search bar on the top of the page.
results.final_text:
User Story:
As a website visitor, I want a search bar positioned at the top of the page so that I can easily access it and quickly locate the content I am looking for.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The search bar should be visible on the top of the page across all devices, achieving an accessibility rate of 100% for users.
- Users must be able to initiate a search within 1 click, with a 95% success rate in finding relevant content based on their queries.
- The search bar should have an average load time of under 1 second to ensure immediate availability.

Test Outline:
- Conduct usability testing to confirm that the search bar is easily accessible and functional on various devices and screen sizes.
- Measure the success rate of searches initiated through the search bar to assess its effectiveness in retrieving relevant content.

- Conduct user testing sessions to evaluate the functionality and effectiveness of the search bar and autocomplete feature.

As a user, I want a search bar positioned at the top of the page so that I can easily access it and conduct searches without having to scroll.

- Time how long it takes for users to initiate a search after locating the search bar during usability testing.
